status_definitions.absent: The capability is not shipped in Perry.
status_definitions.wired: The capability is connected in the product, but this registry has no focused unit evidence.
status_definitions.unit-tested: A focused repository test covers the capability; any recorded live evidence is incomplete or does not yet meet the live-tested gate.
status_definitions.live-tested: A passing parsed structured actual-run artifact binds the capability to its feature, build, environment, and result; release proof is still absent.
status_definitions.release-proven: Passing parsed structured live and release actual-run artifacts bind the capability to the verified build and environment, with a distinct release binary or bundle digest and identity.

limitations: The capture covers the fixture app at revision 4b768c95 on macOS 26.5.1; a different build or enabled provider flows (BYOK Ask/Do, realtime voice) legitimately use the network and are outside this capture's scope.
